Indore Metro Begins Commercial Operations on First Corridor

The Indore Metro has commenced commercial operations on its first operational corridor. The route runs from Gandhi Nagar to the Radisson Square area, covering a significant stretch of the city. Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav and other ministers were present for the inauguration. Commuters can now travel between Super Corridor and Radisson Square starting Saturday.
